text:
pagerbot: [PAGER] Suspicious auth traffic flood detected on auth-edge-2 (prod) — 2,300 401/403s in 5m, elevated header entropy.

eric_oncall: Acknowledged. Investigating now. Any customer impact flagged?

julia_security: Looking at traces, I see repeated attempts from ~45 IPs hitting /v1/auth with mixed UA strings. Some requests contain `Authorization` header snippets in logs — possible accidental logging by indexer.

devon_infra: Confirmed spike from IP range 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. WAF rule prepped. I'm going to add a temporary block + rate-limit.

sara_support: Not yet flagged by support tickets. I'll stand by to notify customers if we confirm leakage.

eric_oncall: devon, apply WAF block, put the session-store write path into debug off and kill any streaming log forwarders to third-party buckets. Tell me when done.

devon_infra: Done: added IP block rule id wf-rot-941, rate-limit to 20r/m for the endpoints, and paused log-forwarder svc indexer-logship-3. Rule: `wg block 203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/24`. :white_check_mark:

julia_security: Good. I'm running quick grep on recent rotated logs for `Authorization:` header leakage. Command:

```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-logs/auth-edge-2/2024-11-05/ - | grep -i "Authorization:"
```

Prelim: found 7 hits in last 24h, likely from indexer debug output. I opened ticket SEC-2024-116.

eric_oncall: If keys were exposed, we need immediate rotation. Which principals could be affected?

julia_security: The hits reference svcacct:indexer-worker and a staging deploy token. We need to rotate indexer service account keys and tighten KMS access for the S3 forwarder. Also rotate any short-lived deploy tokens.

devon_infra: I'll rotate the indexer service key (svc-indexer-rot-2024-11-05). Steps:
- create new key
- update k8s secret in namespace infra-indexer
- restart pods behind deployment indexer-worker

I'll do this now, ETA ~6m.

sara_support: Notifying impacted customers on the watchlist: customers A and C (low-volume). Draft message prepared, will hold until we confirm key rotation complete.

legal_bot: Legal advised: do not disclose specifics of internal log contents. High-level notify: "we observed unusual authentication requests; we've mitigated and are rotating keys". Keep internal audit trail.

eric_oncall: devon — confirm rollout completion and that new key is live.

devon_infra: New key created and deployed. Pods restarted. I validated token exchange on staging -> prod paths. New key id idx-rot-11. Functional tests pass. :white_check_mark:

julia_security: Re-scanning logs after rotation — no new `Authorization:` hits in forwarded logs in last 10m. WAF blocks holding. SEC-2024-116 updated with evidence and next steps (KMS policy tighten + S3 retention scrub).

sara_support: Sending initial customer notice now per legal guidance. Message: "We detected unusual auth attempts affecting tokens used by internal system; we've blocked the traffic and rotated related service credentials. No evidence of customer data access. We'll share updates." :email:

eric_oncall: Good. Next: schedule KMS key rotation for the forwarder, remove debug logging permanently from indexer, and add an eval to the deploy pipeline that rejects PRs enabling request headers in logs.

devon_infra: Raised infra PR to drop header logging and added CI guard. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4123

julia_security: I'll also add monitoring alert for rogue header patterns and a periodic S3 scan for `Authorization` string. Follow-up task: rotate any remaining short-lived tokens and run a forensic search for token usage.

eric_oncall: Handoff time: I'm paged off in 25m. Julia, can you take point for the next 6h? We'll do a quick runbook: 1) confirm WAF holds, 2) verify no new log hits, 3) escalate to legal if evidence of exfiltration, 4) customer comms updates.

julia_security: Taking on-call. I'll update the incident bridge and set cadence every 30m. Tagging @eric_oncall for any questions. :handshake:

devon_infra: Leaving a note in the ticket with command snippets and rollback steps. 

sara_support: On standby for any customer replies. I'll post updates to the customer-impact doc.

pagerbot: Incident SEC-2024-116 status -> mitigated (initial), owner: julia_security, severity: high -> monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m.

julia_security: Adding runbook tasks and closing the immediate rotation loop. Will update again after 30m scan.

eric_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving notes in the oncall log and handing over. :rocket:
